stories.title: 0121_uchuru.md
stories.text: Baba wawe nakuruga uchuru anyua mbere eta sukuru.

stories.title: 0121_uchuru.md
stories.text: "Mami niwe wije kuruga uchuru buuthongi mono," Kinoti arachiera.

stories.title: 0121_uchuru.md
stories.text: "Baba, uchuru buu ibukwenda sukari," Kinoti aramwira.

stories.title: 0121_uchuru.md
stories.text: "Uchuru bwa mami ibu buthongi nkuruki ya baba," arachiera.

stories.title: 0121_uchuru.md
stories.text: "Baba, itubu mpongera sukari," Kinoti arauga.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-makena.md
stories.text:
Ûjû ni mwarimu wakwa.
Ritwa riawe ni mwarimu
Makena.
Niampendete mono.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-makena.md
stories.text:
Mwarimu Makena
niaditananga kuthoma
ntemwa.
Nimbiji kuthoma
a, e, i, o, u.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-makena.md
stories.text:
Mwarimu Makena
nianditananga mantu ja
rangi ta itune na injiru.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-makena.md
stories.text:
Igiita ria kumaama
mwarimu Makena
natwinagira ndwimbo
injega.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-makena.md
stories.text:
Ruumwe I ruru:
Tiga mwaana ii kuriira
Nyakwwe netiree ii kurima
Akeeja na kariguu ka muunda
Tiga mwaana ii kuriira
Nyakwwe netiree ii kurima
Akeeja na kariguu ka muunda

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-makena.md
stories.text:
Mwarimu Makena naiji ngono inyingi na ni a
tugonaira.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-makena.md
stories.text:
Jumatatu atwiraga
ngono cia arume
njorua.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-makena.md
stories.text:
Jumaine agatwira ngono
cia ekuru njorua.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-makena.md
stories.text:
Jumaa yakinya
mwarimu Makena
atweejaga kaanya
tugonera aritwa bangi
turi kiracine.

stories.title: 0283_mwarimu-makena.md
stories.text:
Mwarimu wetu ni
umwega mono na
ndakura ngienda kwaa
ta mwarimu Makena.
